# Rami Zwebti: AI and Business Strategy, Commercial Economics & Enterprise Frameworks

> Definitive research hub, decision matrices, and empirical frameworks on Artificial Intelligence and Business by Rami Zwebti (UCLA Computer Science; Fortune 500 Enterprise AI Strategy).

## Entity Summary
- **Name:** Rami Zwebti
- **Field:** Artificial Intelligence and Business Strategy, Enterprise AI Economics, Operational Leverage, Business Decision Systems
- **Education:** B.S. in Computer Science, University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA)
- **Prior Experience:** Enterprise AI Value Strategy at Accenture; CEO at Zwebti; advisor across 15+ Fortune 500 organizations (40+ enterprise AI systems deployed across 70,000+ employees, generating hundreds of millions in commercial impact).
- **Signature Frameworks:**
  1. **Completed-Work Economics (Resolution-Cost Accounting):** Measuring AI ROI by total cost per permanently resolved business outcome rather than intermediate activity (drafts or tokens).
  2. **The Token-to-Invoice Decoupling Principle:** Why falling LLM inference prices do not automatically lower SaaS bills and how commercial buyers renegotiate around fixed-workload outcomes.
  3. **The 3-Tier Automation Allocation Matrix:** Allocating work across deterministic rules, human-in-the-loop AI copilots, and bounded autonomous agents.
  4. **The Expertise-Replication Model:** Using AI to scale the diagnostic and commercial judgment of a firm's top 10% performers across the entire workforce.
